snippet.title: NOOK FALL: West Town Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
NOOK FALL: West Town, the cozy retro visual novel developed by NarraTruth Games and published by GCORES PUBLISHING, will be released on May 11 for the PC Steam platform (and Mac). 

☕️ NOOK FALL: West Town is an isometric visual novel game. Set in a fictional small town called "West Town," the game revolves around a festival celebration about to take place. As an outsider arriving in West Town, you will, over the course of more than ten days, interact and explore, gradually uncovering the current state of the town and a story from thirty years ago.

It is priced at $13.99 USD. For the first two weeks following the launch, players can enjoy a 10% discount, bringing the price down to just $12.59 USD.

#indiegame #visualnovel #storyrich #retrogame
